about.title: A bit about me.
paragraphs: I am a civil engineer (Ingeniero de Caminos, Canales y Puertos) specialised in integrated infrastructure management and the water cycle. I have worked on site and on design since 2019: wastewater treatment plants, trunk sewers, urban development works and data centres.

My day to day runs from planning and on-site production to cost control and certifications. I like to keep the numbers clear: follow the deadlines, analyse the variances and make every phase profitable.
I also work with data. I use Python applied to engineering, advanced Excel and the fundamentals of artificial intelligence and cloud to automate processes and decide with better information.

items.role: Execution manager, wastewater plant upgrade works
points: Integrated management of the upgrade works at 16 wastewater treatment plants of the Guadarrama Basin Group for Canal de Isabel II, from the technical and economic feasibility study to final execution and handover.
Definition of the strategic planning of the works and deadline tracking.
Cost control, variance analysis, subcontractor management and budget supervision to guarantee the profitability of the upgrades.
Management of on-site production for the upgrade of the Arroyo del Soto wastewater plant to the National Water Quality Plan, with a €14.6M budget for Canal de Isabel II.
Direct support to the Site Manager in defining construction strategies and technical decisions, plus short and medium-term operational planning and cross-trade coordination.
Tracking of production KPIs, analysis of budget variances and cost control, producing certifications and status reports.

items.role: Site Manager and Assistant Site Manager
points: Site Manager on the Cocheras Buenavista urban development (Mar–Oct 2023), for PRYCONSA and Madrid City Council: integrated management, analytical cost control on a €1M budget, subcontractor management and monthly certifications.

Assistant Site Manager on the urban remodelling in Getafe (Dec 2022 – Oct 2023): on-site technical coordination on the access road from the M-406 (Barrio Centro – San Isidro), with €2.4M for Getafe City Council.

Assistant Site Manager on the Villarrozas trunk sewers (Apr 2022 – Feb 2023): support to technical management and execution control of hydraulic infrastructure and service roads (€1.7M) for Canal de Isabel II.

Site and Quality Manager on the urban development of the MAD01 and MAD02 data centres for Microsoft (Oct 2021 – Apr 2022): execution and quality control of two simultaneous projects of €2.2M and €9.8M.
Technical field support and data collection for the design of hydraulic infrastructure improvement projects, notably the Villanueva de la Cañada wastewater plant and the Yeles sewer network.

items.role: Engineering intern, Sales and Studies Department
points: Preparation of technical studies at national and international level.
Design and structuring of a new technical product database, optimising the specifications to create a more intuitive and efficient query tool.
